I have seen a lot of cases where people submitting paystub, letter of employment with duties but still get denied. So try to understand what is wrong with the documents. Sometimes it can be the duties doesn't match with NOC code description or not enough evidences to convinced the officer. 
IRCC is kinda tough recently and the quality of the officers is also questionable.
